mentions.name: Micropay
mentions.description: A payments API for mobile money in Africa, described as what Stripe did for credit cards but for mobile money. It lets developers integrate mobile money payments (such as M-Pesa, where people pay directly from their cell phone number without bank accounts) into their apps in hours instead of the weeks such integrations typically take.
mentions.problem: Integrating payments in Africa is hard: developers spend weeks on what should take hours, and existing solutions like Mastercard, PayPal, and Apple Pay are useless for the 50+ million people in Kenya who pay via M-Pesa and don't have bank accounts.
mentions.audience: Developers building apps in Africa who need to accept mobile money payments from users without bank accounts.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Micropay - Stripe for the next billion people (https://micropay.dev/)

Hi HN, I built this because I got tired of fighting with integrating payments in Africa.
